# openinfra_model_package (Resource)

A versioned, approvable registry record of a trained model artifact (SageMaker Model Registry). Promote an Approved package to a served endpoint via openinfra_model's `serve`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image` (String) The serving container image that loads this artifact — what `serve` uses to promote it.
- `model_name` (String) The model group/family this is a version of (group versions by this name).
- `name` (String) Resource name. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `approval_status` (String) Approval gate. One of `PendingManualApproval`, `Approved`, `Rejected`. Defaults to `PendingManualApproval`.
- `artifact` (Attributes) The trained model artifact in the object store. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--artifact))
- `description` (String) Optional human description of this version.
- `framework` (String) Optional framework label (e.g. `pytorch`).
- `metrics` (String) Optional evaluation metrics as a JSON string.
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `port` (Number) Serving port. Defaults to `8000`.
- `version` (String) Version label within the group. Defaults to `1`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `namespace/name`, the import identifier.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the resource's Ready condition is True. Terraform returns as soon as the object is accepted, so this is usually `false` immediately after apply — the platform reconciles asynchronously.

<a id="nestedatt--artifact"></a>
### Nested Schema for `artifact`

Required:

- `bucket` (String)

Optional:

- `key` (String) Object key of the artifact.
